title: Legacy program recruits psionic assets from native cultures

tellings.quote: so-called legacy program working with what they called psionic assets to lure UFOs has been reaching out to people from native cultures around the world, especially young children who have never been taught that this is impossible.

related.note: Both say a program recruits young people from around the world. This telling says children from native cultures are recruited as psionic assets to lure UFOs, while the story says they are gathered to pilot craft at black facilities.

plain: A so-called legacy program, a long-running secret effort that works with psionic assets (people with claimed psychic abilities) to lure UFOs, has been reaching out to people from native cultures around the world, especially young children who were never taught that such things are impossible. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove says this on Michels' show, passing on what he has heard without naming who told him. The idea is that untaught minds are better at making contact.
